name: Agriculture
description: Crop monitoring, precision irrigation, livestock operations, greenhouse environmental control, and grain storage management.

sub_industries.name: Field / Crop Monitoring
sub_industries.description: In-field environmental monitoring for precision agriculture including soil conditions, microclimate, and crop health.

device_types.name: Field Sensor Node
device_types.description: Multi-sensor node deployed in agricultural fields measuring soil and atmospheric conditions for precision irrigation and crop management.

tags.name: Soil Moisture (Shallow)
tags.description: Volumetric soil moisture at shallow depth (6–12 inches). Primary irrigation trigger measurement.

tags.name: Soil Moisture (Deep)
tags.description: Volumetric soil moisture at deeper depth (24–36 inches). Indicates root zone water availability.

tags.name: Soil Temperature
tags.description: Soil temperature affecting seed germination, root growth, and microbial activity.

tags.name: Air Temperature
tags.description: Ambient air temperature at the field location.

tags.name: Relative Humidity
tags.description: Relative humidity used for evapotranspiration calculations and disease risk modeling.

tags.name: Rainfall
tags.description: Cumulative rainfall in millimeters. Used to adjust irrigation scheduling.

sub_industries.name: Irrigation
sub_industries.description: Irrigation system monitoring and control including pumps, zone valves, and flow measurement.

device_types.name: Irrigation Controller
device_types.description: Automated irrigation zone controller managing water application to crop fields or turf.

tags.name: System Pressure
tags.description: Irrigation system pressure. Low pressure indicates pump failure or line breaks.

tags.name: Volume Applied
tags.description: Total water volume applied in the current or last irrigation cycle.

sub_industries.name: Grain Storage
sub_industries.description: Grain bin monitoring for temperature, moisture, and aeration management to prevent spoilage.

device_types.name: Grain Bin
device_types.description: Grain storage bin with temperature cable and moisture monitoring for spoilage prevention and quality preservation.

tags.name: Grain Temperature (Upper)
tags.description: Grain temperature in the upper zone of the bin. Hot spots indicate spoilage activity.

tags.name: Grain Temperature (Lower)
tags.description: Grain temperature in the lower zone of the bin.

tags.name: Grain Moisture
tags.description: Grain moisture content. Safe storage typically requires below 14% for corn, 13% for soybeans.

tags.name: Fill Level
tags.description: Bin fill level as a percentage of total capacity.
